body: The lamplighter swapped the lamp. There was just one mark on the tag: Reed. More than one person was on watch. My master said the one on duty always comes back. I heard the old river song, but did not see a face.
The deckhand knew that song, too.
Cen called anyone on the lamp shift the lamplighter.
The enclosed letter named Han Lu. He was the one who switched the lamp. My master never came; Han was the one I heard.
The lamp was exchanged by Reed. That was the alias Han Lu used on the watch list.
Quien cuidaba el farol lo cambió en el lugar acordado. Solo dejó la marca Junco. Había más de un turno esa noche.
Mi maestro decía que la persona de guardia siempre regresaba. Oí su cantar, sin verle la cara. El ayudante también lo sabía.
El papel todavía no permitía descartar a la otra persona.
El signo Junco lleva al nombre de Han Lu, como dice la carta.
The mark Reed was a clue to the identity confirmed in the box letter.
An entry in the watch log connected Reed with the person who drew the silver line.
The ship log adds that Han Lu used a silver line to mark his watch. The deckhand knew the old song, too.
Cen llamaba guardafarol a cualquiera que llevara el turno.
